svg.title: Thompson Health Region - reconstructed monochrome logo
svg.desc: New vector reconstruction made 22 November 2026. Original production vector not recovered. Symbol geometry follows monochrome Thompson Health Region letterheads dated 9 September 1999, 9 June 2000 and 1 November 2001. Colour samples follow the historical raster on PDF page 71 (printed 63) of Environment Canada proceedings, catalogue En40-240-1/03-00E-PDF (2003): teal #00687A and ochre #C47900. These are sampled RGB values, not official colour specifications. Name lettering is a fitted EB Garamond weight 500 substitute; tagline is a fitted Nimbus Roman Italic substitute. Original typefaces remain unidentified. Lettering is black from the monochrome reference; its historical colour has not been established. Name and tagline are outlined editable paths. Combined colour arrangement is reconstructed from separate sources.
